title: intentd's notices that carry a remedy open with no severity token, so a failure reads like a record
body:
**Thirteen intentd notices print a `remedy:` line under an opening that carries no severity token**, so nothing that reads intentd's logs can tell a failure from a record by the line's own words. Intent.app's Console (ST0075 WP-02) colours lines by the CLI's own tokens (`error:`, `caused by:` and `intentd: could not` as errors, `warning:` and `remedy:` as warnings), and each of these renders as a plain log line with a warning-coloured remedy under it, which reads backwards. A reader of `intent daemon logs` in a terminal has the same problem without the colour.

Found by critic-swift's review of ST0075 WP-02, as an advisory flagged for architectural review. Measured at the tree of `4c5204c82` by scanning `native/rust/crates/intentd/src` for `eprintln!` and `println!` literals that open `intentd: `, do not open `intentd: could not`, and carry a `remedy:` line:

| Site | Opening |
| --- | --- |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/main.rs:352` | `intentd: the HTTP face stopped answering: {e}` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/main.rs:761` | `intentd: a subscriber fell {missed} event(s) behind and was disconnected` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/registry.rs:153` | ``intentd: `{}` is being SERVED and NOT WATCHED: {message}`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/registry.rs:163` | ``intentd: the watcher for `{}` answered a refusal with {other:?}`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/store.rs:671` | ``intentd: ingesting `{}` after an external edit failed: {}`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/store.rs:716` | ``intentd: the scheduled backup of `{}` failed: {}`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/store.rs:746` | ``intentd: `{}` is NOT being backed up: backup.schedule is {value:?}, which is not one of hourly, daily, weekly`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/watch.rs:256` | ``intentd: the index watcher for `{}` reported an error: {error}`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/watch.rs:283` | `intentd: {message}` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/watch.rs:287` | `intentd: the store refused an index refresh with {other:?}` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/watch.rs:393` | ``intentd: watching `{}` failed: {error}`` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/watch.rs:459` | `intentd: {message}` |
| `native/rust/crates/intentd/src/watch.rs:462` | `intentd: the store refused an ingest with {other:?}` |

Not in the list: notices that already open `intentd: could not`, which the Console colours as errors, and notices that already open `warning:` or `error:`, such as intentd's accept and LaunchAgent warnings.

**Ruled by vc on 2026-09-15 (option (iii)): the fix is intentd's.** Each of these notices opens with `warning:` or `error:`, as the accept and LaunchAgent notices already do. The fix rides in dc's 0321 bank, which rewrites every intentd log line, and dc's landing closes this issue together with 0321. The Console needs no change for it: it matches the tokens once they are there, after the RFC 3339 UTC stamp that 0321 puts at the head of every line of both logs.


**CLOSED 2026-09-15, landed on vc's word at 1461f58ff in 0321's commit.** Each of the thirteen notices above now opens `warning:`, the token intentd's accept and LaunchAgent notices already carry, and nothing else in its text changed: all thirteen are conditions the daemon survives. Every line also carries 0321's stamp, and the Console classifies what follows it.
